reason: A source audit found three model-input defects that do not depend on measured room-temperature residuals: the published 81.69 m2 lower-to-attic ceiling was assigned wholly to the aggregated ground airbody instead of the three lower-room footprints; measured mechanical supply and exhaust channels were collapsed into one balanced flow; and the measured RadiationIR_global sky forcing was discarded while opaque exterior radiative exchange was absent. Protocol 1.5 freezes the source-derived topology, distinct supply/exhaust enthalpy terms, and explicit opt-in sol-air boundary contract before rerunning the Extended diagnostic.
unchanged_from_v1_4: window, kitchen-door, attic-hatch, and blind source schedules

corrected_boundary_mapping.ceiling_topology: The published 81.69 m2 lower ceiling is partitioned by the source-plan footprints: 63.06 m2 ground, 7.44 m2 kitchen, and 11.19 m2 sleeping; the 0.7923 m2 trap door is subtracted only from the ground-to-attic opaque area.
corrected_boundary_mapping.mechanical_ventilation: SUA supply flow and temperature form the incoming enthalpy term; EHA exhaust flow forms the outgoing zone-air enthalpy term. Omitted exhaust retains the legacy balanced-flow behavior.
corrected_boundary_mapping.opaque_radiative_boundary: Outdoor opaque surfaces use an opt-in sol-air term with source-reported solar absorptance 0.23, source construction Rse 0.04 m2K/W (hse 25 W/m2K), declared longwave emissivity assumption 0.90, measured RadiationIR_global converted to effective sky temperature, and isotropic plane-of-array irradiance.
corrected_boundary_mapping.array_backend: Distinct supply/exhaust and opaque sol-air terms are rejected explicitly until implemented; they are not silently ignored.

scientific_label: Results under v1.5 remain post-unsealing corrected diagnostics. The immutable first holdout result remains published and rejected. This amendment cannot restore a blind-validation claim.
